requirements_before_admission: Complete typed propagation through approximation kernels, stopping interruption and precision failures before any cache publication. Do not use a zero or panic to represent failed numeric evaluation.

Replace remaining unchecked precision arithmetic at actual work sites, including offset children, constant fallbacks, series planning and nested kernel precision. The initial i32::MIN check alone is insufficient.

Migrate fallible public callers and preserve honest Unknown/Option/domain-error boundaries; infallible symbolic constructors need valid deferred or checked reduction paths, never fabricated numeric fallbacks.
Review cache publication and cancellation resets: a checked pre/post wrapper alone cannot identify a partial value after its external flag has been cleared. A failure must remain explicit.
Carry scalar precision/resource accounting into actual predicate/curve paths; the existing hypersolve attempt counters explicitly exclude scalar work and do not prove whole-operation bounds.
Replay all baseline cases, cold/matching/finer-cache controls, ordinary retries, and poisoned-cache processes. Add deterministic regressions and independent valid-result oracles.
Validate complete affected scalar/predicate/curve/downstream configurations plus proportionate timing/allocation/size and original full-resolution reports before admitting runtime changes.
public_api_note: Returning Result from existing approximation method names is under evaluation; all call sites, documentation, and release implications must be handled before admission.
